_comment: A query node's harness config (V50 User Tasks). It advertises plansheet.query and answers the RunSQL action by running the SQL it receives on STDIN against a database connection, printing the rows as the answer. Plansheet dispatches { Capability: plansheet.query, Action: RunSQL } for a task whose prompt shape assembles to a SQL query; the assembled SQL arrives on this command's stdin (and is also available as the {Input} placeholder). SAFETY, READ THIS: this command runs whatever SQL it is handed, so point PLANSHEET_QUERY_DB_URL at a READ-ONLY Postgres role -- the read-only role IS the safety boundary. Author tasks with the whole query in a Fixed shape segment (see dev/user-tasks-seed.js), never with user-substituted SQL text, so a person filling a form can never change the query. Replace Command/Args with your own psql (or a query runner) and set PLANSHEET_QUERY_DB_URL in the node's environment before starting the runner.

RunSQL.Description: Run the SQL received on stdin against a read-only database connection and return the rows (tab separated).
